spans.s:
r. 1st cl. form irr. (शृणोति)
To hear:
form reg. (श्रवति)
To go, to move, especially as a fluid, to drop, to ooze, to flow.
With प्रति or सम् prefixed,
To promise, to assent or agree to.
With वि,
To be famous.

r. 1st cl. (स्रवति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To flow.
3 To drop, to distil, to ooze.

f. (स्रूः)
A sacrificial ladle: see स्रुव.
2 A cascade.
E.
स्रु to drop, (Ghee from it,) Uṇādi aff. क्किप्, and the vowel made long.

m. (-रुः)
A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)

f. (-का)
Natron, alkali.

Heard.
2

Understood.
n. (-तं)
1 Sacred science, holy writ, &c.
2 The object of hearing, that which is heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Flowing, dropping, falling, as a fluid.
f. (-ता)
A drug, commonly Hingupatri.
E.
स्रु to flow, aff. क.

mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति)
Famous, celebrated.
m. (-र्त्तिः)
1 A divine sage.
2 A generous man, a benefactor, a donor.
f. (-र्त्तिः)
1 A river.
2 The wife of BHARATA.
E.
श्रुत heard, कीर्त्ति fame.

f. (-वी)
SARASVATĪ.
E.
श्रुत that which is heard, (science, &c.) and देवी presiding deity.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Recollecting, remembering what has been heard.
2 Having or observing the Vedas.
E.
श्रुत, and घर who has.

m. (-र्षिः)
A Ṛṣi of a particular order; one by whom holy writ has been heard, not taught; as the author of the Suśruta, a medical work, the son of VIŚVĀMITRA, &c.
E.
श्रुत heard, and ऋषि a saint.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Hearing, having heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-जः)
The planet ŚANI or SATURN.
E.
श्रुतश्रवस् one of the other sons of SŪRYA, and अनुज younger born.

n. (-नं)
Citing the Vedas.
E.
श्रुत holy writ, and आदान referring to, taking.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Well read in sacred science, conversant with the Vedas, and the branches of knowledge or philosophy, dependant on them.
E.
श्रुत heard, (knowledge of grammar, &c. that has been taught viva voce,) अध्ययन perusal, (of the Vedas,) सस्पन्न accomplished.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Acquainted with or conforming to the Vedas.
E.
श्रुत, and अन्वित possessed of.

f. (-तिः)
1 The Vedas, severally or collectively, scripture, holy writ.
2 An ear.
3

Hearing.
4

Intelligence, news, rumour, report.
5 (In music,) A division of the octave, a quarter tone or interval, of which twenty-two are enumerated; four constituting a major tone, three a minor, and two a semitone: the Śrutis are personified as nymphs.
6 The constellation Śravaṇā.
E.
श्रु to hear, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-टः)
1 Penance, expiation.
2 A snake.
E.
श्रुति the Vedas, or an ear, &c., and कट to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taught or prescribed by the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति as above, and कथित said, declared.

n. (-नं)
Holy precept or injunction, the doctrine of the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति, and चोदन saying.

f. (-का)
Law, the code of laws.
E.
श्रुति the Vedas, and जीविका living; existing according to scripture.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Hearing, having ears.
2 Studying the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and तत्पर attentive.

n. (-धं)
Disagreement or contradiction of any two passages in the Vedas, or of two Vedas.
E.
श्रुति, and द्वैध difference.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Having, being versed in, or observing the

Vedas.
2

Hearing.
E.
श्रुति, and घर who or what has.

Hearing.
2

Observing, obeying.
3 Having or following the Vedas.
E.
श्रुत, and इनि aff.

n. (-लं)
1 The root of the ear.
2 The text of the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति, and मूल root.

n. (-लं)
The outer ear.
E.
श्रुति, and मण्डल circle.

Deaf.
2

Ignorant or unread in the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and वर्ज्जित abandoned, lost.

m. (-यः)
An object or doctrine of the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति. and विषय an object.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Scriptural, declared by the Vedas and the law.
E.
श्रुति, and स्मृति and विहित said.

m. (-सः)
Alliteration.
E.
श्रुति hearing, and अनुप्रास similarity of sound.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Said or enjoined by the Vedas.
E.
श्रुति, and उक्त said; also श्रुत्युदित, &c.

ind.
Having heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, क्त्वा aff.

m. (-वः)
Sacrifice, oblation.
n. (-वं)
A sort of ladle used for pouring Ghee or oiled butter at a sacrifice.
E.
श्रु to ooze or leak, aff. क, more usually श्रुव, &c.

mf. (-वः-वा)
A ladle with a double extremity, or two oval collateral excavations, made of wood, and used to pour Ghee upon the sacrificial fire.
f. (-वा)
1 A shrub, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
2 A tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
E.
स्रु to drop or ooze, (from or by it,) aff. क.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Hearing.
E.
श्रु to hear, reiterated, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Hearing, being hearing.
E.
श्रु to hear, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-रुः)
A plant, (Flacourtia sapida.)
E.
स्रुच् a sacrificial ladle, and दारु wood.

f. (-ध्नी)
Natron, alkali.

f. (स्रुक् or स्रुग्)
A sort of ladle or long spoon, generally made of wood, and used to pour Ghee or clarified butter upon the sacrificial fire.
E.
स्रु to drop, (Ghee,) क्विप् aff., and चिट् final augment.

m. (-क्षः)
A plant, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.)
E.
स्रुवा a sacrificial ladle, and वृक्ष a tree.
